subject: Annual planning kickoff — trigger matrix, scenario owners and timelines
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Annual planning kickoff — trigger matrix, scenario owners and timelines

Team — kicking off the annual planning thread for FY27/QBR inputs. Goal is to land a succinct set of scenarios (Conservative / Base / Upside) and a simple trigger matrix with named owners so we can run sensitivity quickly during the exec QBR. Please read below and respond with owners/inputs by the deadlines.

Summary & asks:
- Deliverable: scenario trigger matrix (attached) + initial target deltas for each org (headcount, ARR, bookings)
- What I need from each of you: 1) initial targets for Conservative/Base/Upside; 2) 2–3 high-probability triggers that would move us between scenarios; 3) named owner for each trigger (single owner + backup)
- Deadlines: initial targets & owners due EOD Thursday Dec 3; consolidated sensitivity run by Dec 8; final numbers for QBR by Dec 15
- Please use the attached workbook (2027_planning_trigger_matrix.xlsx) — tab "team_inputs" — and drop any supporting notes in the Drive link below.

Context / proposed default assumptions:
- Base assumes 30% ARR growth, normalized CAC, HC ramp per HC_Ramp_Scenarios (attached)
- Conservative assumes -15% top-line from Base; Upside assumes +20%
- Cash runway guardrails: if revenue < Conservative for two consecutive months, hiring pause tiering activates (details in sheet)

Immediate asks (for this week):
- Jonas: lead Sales targets & name triggers tied to managed accounts (inc. Acme Health)
- Laura: Ops & infra cost sensitivity + suggested batch/caching knobs to test for cost savings in downside
- Vivek: finance runway scenarios and suggested hiring pause tiers (I noted an initial proposal in the sheet)

Attachments: 2027_planning_trigger_matrix.xlsx (workbook), hc_ramp_scenarios.pdf (headcount assumptions)

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_planning/QBR-2027-inputs

Thanks — will consolidate Friday and push a short exec-ready slide by Dec 10.

— Marissa

Subject: Re: Annual planning kickoff — trigger matrix, scenario owners and timelines

Thanks Marissa — will do. Two asks from Ops side I want to surface now so we include them in the sensitivity runs:
1) Include a HC ramp sensitivity that separates engineering vs SRE vs support (I attached the HC_RAMP_SCENARIOS.pdf with recommended monthly cadence).
2) Please make sure we have a row-level cost sensitivity for infra (GPU hours) vs managed-hosted revenue mix — that’s where we see the largest unit-cost swing.

I’ll add owners in the sheet and propose a small set of cost mitigations (e.g., 3-day cache TTL increase, staging-only quantization tests) that can be toggled in the model.

— Laura
VP, Platform Operations
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:40:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual planning kickoff — trigger matrix, scenario owners and timelines

Marissa / team — agree with timeline. Two additional points from finance perspective:
- Please assume a conservative cash model where delayed collections (60+ days) reduce near-term free cash by up to 12% in the Conservative case. We need the sensitivity on collections timing as a separate switch in the workbook.
- Recommend an explicit hiring-pause ladder (Tier 1: pause non-critical IC hires at -5% vs plan; Tier 2: pause most hiring at -10%; Tier 3: freeze at -20%). We should name an owner for each tier to enable fast execution.

I’ll slot Markus on the scenario modeling (he has the template macros). Markus — can you take the consolidated workbook and produce three P&L runs by Dec 8?

Also: happy to loop in our advisor Marta Lopez (Greenlane) for a quick sanity check on runway math — adding her here for visibility.

— Vivek
Chief Operating Officer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmehealth.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@greenlanecap.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Annual planning kickoff — consolidated next steps and owners

Forwarding consolidated plan & next steps after the first round of inputs. Highlights below — full workbook and consolidated owner list are attached.

Decisions / progress:
- Initial targets received for Sales / Ops / Product — we have Base/Conservative/Upside populated for most orgs.
- Triggers identified: New multi-year deal (Acme Health) -> Upside; Net retention < 90% -> move to Conservative; Free cash reduction > 10% for two months -> trigger Tiered hiring pause.
- Owners assigned (see contingency_owner_list.csv). Jonas owns Acme deal trigger; Vivek + Markus own hiring-pause execution; Laura owns infra mitigations.

Next steps & timeline:
- Markus to run consolidated P&Ls for the three scenarios and post to Drive by Dec 8.
- Leadership to review slides (I’ll circulate a 6-slide exec pack) by Dec 10.
- Final numbers locked for QBR by Dec 15; pre-read to go out Dec 13.

Attachments: contingency_owner_list.csv, consolidated_workbook (see Drive link)

If no objections I’ll mark this as the planning baseline and we’ll iterate with finance/ops next week.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn.

— Marissa
VP of Finance & Strategy | Redwood Inference
